name: Border coal to district heat
description: A rule-based OpenRepublic logistics loop exports grain, imports coal at a trade post when the heating plant lacks fuel, and dispatches parked depot trucks from stocked buildings to the plant.
catalog:
openrepublic-economy 1
utility power
resource grain
resource coal
resource heat
trade grain buy 1 sell 1
trade coal buy 1 sell 1
building border_post 1 1
  store grain 80
  store coal 80
  recipe produce_export_goods every 1 out grain:4
  tradepost
end
building road_depot 1 1
  depot
  fleet truck 2
  handling 2 1
end
building storage 1 1
  store coal 80
  store heat 20
end
building heating_plant 1 1
  store coal 80
  store heat 100
  recipe generate_heat every 1 in coal:1 out heat:1
end
vehicle truck capacity 8 speed 1
